title: Train journey from Będzin to Cairo
summary: Eight people from Będzin were among fifteen who boarded a train for Cairo on Passover eve 1919; the passage does not identify them as the pictured Third Aliyah pioneers.
uncertaintyNote: The passage says eight Będzin residents were among fifteen train passengers; it does not identify them individually.
